examined_formations.title: CHINA_CROSS_SYSTEM_INTERNAL_MARKETING_OPERATIONS_APPROVAL_AUTOMATION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 中国跨系统内部营销运营的提案、审批与写回自动化
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: A July 2026 Chinese participant described an internal marketing tool delayed for almost four years because business knowledge had to cross product, engineering and testing handoffs, then reached a runnable trial in roughly five focused development days by working directly with AI.

The live flow spans three internal systems for audience/behavior data, product/order/inventory/campaign/member state and customer outreach, and the participant explicitly retained dry-run and human approval before price, membership, coupon or outreach write actions.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: The company already controls the source systems, accounts, internal business rules and the right to read and conditionally write the relevant operational state.
The underused asset is fragmented internal knowledge and API-accessible state that previously remained stranded behind translation, prioritization and coordination overhead.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: Before the new implementation, the participant repeatedly translated operational rules into diagrams, product specifications, reviews, engineering estimates and test cases, with personnel or rule changes resetting the chain.
The current workaround compresses that chain into AI-assisted adapter construction, deterministic checks, dry-run previews, approval gates, logs, smoke tests and bounded write-back.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: This is a strong participant-controlled digital-action fit because the organization owns the credentials and most decisive write permissions.

But the valuable residue is highly company-specific: changing API fields, data semantics, fragmented business rules and risk policy still require local configuration and maintenance rather than exposing a reusable neutral routing edge.
economic_signal: A four-year delayed internal capability becoming testable within days demonstrates material internal time-to-value and avoided coordination cost.

No independent external buyer, recurring settlement or reusable cross-company control surface is evidenced; the same evidence can describe bespoke internal integration rather than a founder-independent business.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: n8n currently provides self-hostable workflow automation, custom API connections, deterministic logic, AI agents, human-in-the-loop approvals and error/fallback control across a large integration surface.
Dify Workflow Studio currently supports tools, custom APIs, code, triggers, branching, human review, failure handling and run tracing.
General coding agents can rapidly build or modify the remaining company-specific adapters when the organization already controls system access.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_TEAM_SMS_OTP_ROUTING_AND_SHARED_ACCOUNT_CODE_DISTRIBUTION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 中国团队共享账号短信验证码的规则路由与部门分发
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: A March 2026 Chinese participant described a team managing many official-account, Zhihu and ecommerce identities through old Android phones plus SmsForwarder, with missed messages, device crashes and a former employee nearly taking a primary-account verification code.
The participant built a Cat.1 hardware gateway plus cloud SaaS so refund codes and login codes could be routed to different team channels and reported a roughly 1.5-second delivery path.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: The team controls the SIM/device receiving the SMS and the destination collaboration channels, so parsing, classification, routing, retry and audit can occur inside participant-authorized systems after message receipt.

The shared-account environment creates repeated routing and access-separation pressure because codes for different business lines must reach different operational groups without handing one employee unrestricted access.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: The prior route used old Android phones, SmsForwarder and DingTalk; another discussed route used Raspberry Pi or scripts plus regex and enterprise-messaging APIs.
The participant replaced that with a dedicated gateway, local queue/retry and a visual cloud routing layer with regex rules and team permissions.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: This formation proves stronger economic motion than a hypothetical automation idea because the participant publicly quoted a device buyout plan and a recurring team plan.

However the basic SMS monitoring and rules-based forwarding control surface is already occupied by mature open-source tooling, while the remaining reliability advantage depends on dedicated hardware, SIM/carrier availability and external identity-provider MFA policy.
economic_signal: The participant quoted a 199 CNY device buyout with base SaaS and a team plan at 99 CNY per month or 998 CNY per year for advanced regex-based routing and team use.
Those prices demonstrate a live monetization attempt but not an unowned market edge; the participant's own product already occupies the proposed gateway-plus-cloud route.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: pppscn/SmsForwarder is an established open-source Android tool that monitors SMS, calls and app notifications and routes them by rules to DingTalk, WeCom, Feishu, email, Bark, webhook, Telegram and other destinations.
SmsForwarder supports content/source/card-slot rule matching and forwarding logs, directly covering the basic rules-based message-distribution layer.
The participant's current gateway-plus-SaaS implementation itself is an exact active incumbent for the hardware-decoupled routing edge.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_AGENT_CODING_WORKTREE_LOCAL_ASSET_SYNCHRONIZATION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 中国 Agent 编程多 worktree 场景的本地未跟踪资产同步
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: A September 21, 2026 Chinese developer using Codex with parallel git worktrees reported that company policy prevents committing the .agents directory, so project research, issue documents and project-level skills are absent when new worktrees are created.
The participant also asked how updates to untracked files can flow back and how conflicts should be handled when multiple worktrees modify the same local asset.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: The developer and company control the local agent assets, skills and worktree filesystem state; creation, copy, link and synchronization actions are fully machine-executable on the developer's own machine.
The friction is caused by intentionally keeping useful project context outside tracked git history while simultaneously expecting parallel worktrees to share and reconcile it.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: Community responses proposed a worktree-creation skill that copies the required assets, moving repository-level agent assets to an external shared directory, links/hooks and purpose-built worktree tooling.
The discussion explicitly notes that automatic multi-worktree merging without putting the files under version control creates an inherent conflict-management tension.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: This is an unusually clean participant-controlled digital-action case: local filesystem and worktree operations need no external business permission.

But that same openness makes the workflow low-barrier: current tools and short scripts can copy or link ignored files, while durable conflict resolution requires introducing an authoritative version/history model rather than a new commercial router.
economic_signal: Parallel agent coding makes context loss and repeated setup costly in developer time, especially when several worktrees are active.
No independent recurring payer evidence, settlement rail or broad buyer-controlled economic surface is proven in the current participant record.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: Worktrunk currently exposes `wt step copy-ignored` to copy gitignored files between worktrees, supports lifecycle hooks and can constrain copied assets through `.worktreeinclude`.
Worktrunk documents source/destination worktree selection, dry-run/force options and JSON output, making the operation directly automatable by agents.
Simple scripts, symlinks or a shared external asset directory can also solve the one-source-many-worktrees propagation problem without a new service.
